name: Amikacin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 15 mg/kg/day IM or IV in 2 or 3 equal doses; maximum 1.5 g/day; usually 7 to 10 days

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other nephrotoxic or neurotoxic drugs (vancomycin, amphotericin B, colistin, polymyxin B, cisplatin, other aminoglycosides)
key_interactions.action: Avoid; if needed, monitor levels and kidney function.

serious: Irreversible hearing loss and vestibular toxicity (boxed warning)

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to amikacin (history of serious reaction to other aminoglycosides may also contraindicate)

pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 98% unchanged in urine within 24 hours
pk.dialyzability: Yes, by hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis (label)
